description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small engineering team building a B2B SaaS platform for user-led growth. You will own the production infrastructure and reliability foundations that help the team deliver confidently as the product scales.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect, deploy, and operate AWS infrastructure across compute, messaging, storage, networking, and observability.

 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support automated deployments from commit to production.

 - Operate PostgreSQL in production, including configuration, performance tuning, migrations, and backup and restore strategies.

 - Make pragmatic tradeoffs between delivery speed and foundational system quality.

 - Work with product teams and stakeholders to shape architecture and technical direction.

 - Apply AI-assisted development tools where useful in development and delivery workflows.

 - Investigate complex distributed-systems issues and deliver reliable solutions at scale.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or founding engineering.

 - Deep, hands-on AWS and Terraform experience operating production infrastructure, with a preference for infrastructure managed as code.

 - Production PostgreSQL experience, including connection pooling, migrations, optimization, and backup and restore.

 - Experience operating high-traffic or highly available production systems.

 - Working familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js application code, including NestJS.

 - Experience building production CI/CD pipelines and handling distributed-systems concerns such as ordering, idempotency, retries, at-least-once delivery, and partial failures.

 - Familiarity with agentic coding tools, alongside the technical judgment to debug and make architecture decisions independently.

 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive salary and employee stock options. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Fully remote within Europe, with residence within three hours of Central European Time.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments
locationText: United Kingdom | Denmark | Germany | Portugal | Sweden | Spain | Netherlands | United Kingdom
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong.

If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will:

 - Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others).

 - Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.

 - Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging.

 - Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities.

 - Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers.

 - Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations.




WHAT YOU BRING

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

 - Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar).

 - Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling.

 - Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability.

 - Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems.

 - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana).

 - Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus.

 - Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity.

 - High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation.

 - Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality.

 - Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development.

 - A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation.

 - A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates.




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Bank Infrastructure and work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, finance operations, compliance, and other engineering squads within Pleo's Payments organisation. Bank Infrastructure is foundational to nearly everything Pleo does, your work will have direct dependencies with and from Card Infrastructure, Credit, and beyond. You'll collaborate with partners across the business to shape how Pleo moves money reliably at scale.




HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first six months at Pleo, you'll:

 - Get deep into Pleo's payment rail architecture, understanding how inbound and outbound bank payment flows are built, monitored, and operated.

 - Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in the bank integration or payment operations domain and drive them from design to production.

 - Build relationships across the engineering organisation, contributing to code reviews and technical discussions beyond your immediate team.

 - Grow your expertise in high-reliability, mission-critical financial infrastructure while contributing to Pleo's broader engineering

description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users.

This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


FEATURE DEVELOPMENT

 - Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements

 - Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions

 - Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale

 - Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks


QUALITY & RELIABILITY

 - Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects

 - Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour

 - Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues

 - Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size


SECURITY & OBSERVABILITY

 - Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets

 - Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling


COLLABORATION

 - Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release

 - Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes

 - Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing

 - Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers




QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript

 - Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals

 - Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui

 - Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations

 - Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI

 - Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code

 - English — B1+


LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

 - Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches

 - Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed

 - Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested

 - Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team

 - Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them

 - Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom




LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

description:
About Dashlane
Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.
We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane , including how we work , how we hire , and the benefits of being a Dashlaner .
About the role:
Join Dashlane as an Engineering Manager leading the Monetization Engineering team , the financial and transactional engine powering Dashlane’s global growth. Millions of users and world-class B2B organizations rely on Dashlane every day, and your team owns the mission-critical infrastructure that turns product value into revenue: checkout flows, recurring subscription lifecycles, payment processor integrations, trial conversions, and plans & pricing packaging. When a user upgrades their account or an enterprise expands their subscription, your team’s systems ensure that high-stakes transaction is frictionless, bulletproof, and instantaneous.
You will have deep technical ownership of Dashlane’s billing and subscription architecture. This includes stewarding current and future billing systems, driving complex system migrations, and consolidating global payment gateways. In Monetization, high availability and transactional consistency are non-negotiable: you are operating the single most revenue-sensitive systems at Dashlane.
As a leader, you aren't just shipping features; you are cultivating an ownership-driven engineering culture. You will lead, coach, and champion a high-caliber, distributed team of server and web engineers. Working in tight synergy with Product, Design, Finance, and Data, you will foster technical excellence, operational rigor, and psychological safety, delivering platforms and workflows that directly drive ARR, reduce churn, and scale our commercial footprint.
Location:
You will be based in Lisbon, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.
At Dashlane, you will:
•
Lead and cultivate a high-trust, high-accountability team: Coach, support, and mentor a distributed group of server and web engineers, empowering them to deliver independently with low friction and high impact.
•
Own the transactional backbone: Oversee the architecture and operational health of Dashlane’s billing system, subscription lifecycle engines, checkout experiences, and internal back-office administration tools.
•
Drive complex technical initiatives & migrations: Actively shape technical strategy, author and review Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and guide large-scale efforts that de-risk the platform as we scale upmarket.
•
Bridge business strategy and technical execution: Partner deeply with Product Management, Design, and cross-functional partners in Finance, Data, and Legal to rapidly test, iterate, and roll out new plans, tiers, and pricing models without compromising billing integrity.
•
Champion system reliability & data integrity: Treat zero-downtime, financial accuracy, and data consistency as primary product features—ensuring our transactional ledgers and subscription states are always resilient and auditable.
•
Maintain a secure, low-scope compliance posture: Ensure billing and payment integrations correctly leverage our processors' PCI compliance to keep Dashlane's own PCI scope minimal, while partnering with Security and Legal on data-handling and regulatory requirements as we expand into new markets and payment methods.
•
Accelerate engineering efficiency & AI adoption: Foster continuous improvement across our SDLC , leveraging modern tools and AI workflows to accelerate delivery, reduce toil, and streamline debugging.
•
Participate in engineering hiring & community: Recruit and hire exceptional software engineers while championing Dashlane’s engineering brand within the broader tech community.
Requirements:
•
5+ years of experience in software engineering
•
2+ years of experience in people and project management (ideally in a distributed environment)
•
Fluency in English
What we’re looking for:
•
Demonstrated Engineering Leadership: Proven track record of managing and growing high-performing engineering teams (including senior and staff levels) in a modern, distributed/remote environment
•
Systems & Architectural Acumen: Strong background in distributed backend systems, event-driven architectures, relational databases, and transactional integrity. You can challenge technical designs, weigh trade-offs pragmatically, and identify bottlenecks before they impact production.
•
Cross-Functional Fluency: Comfort partnering not just with PMs and designers, but directly with finance and operational stakeholders where business requirements demand extreme precision.

Decisive & Action-Oriented: A pragmatic, bias-toward-progress approach—skilled at slicing complex technical migrations into safe, iterative phases while keeping team momentum high.
•
Security Mindset: Strong interest in cybersecurity

title: Senior Node.js Developer (Portugal)
description:
Who We Are
Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.
We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.
Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.
Why This Role Exists
We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.
This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.
What You’ll Build
• High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
• Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
• Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
• CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
• Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale
Requirements
Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.
Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements
• 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
• Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
• Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
• Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
• Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
• Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
• Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.
Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)
• Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
• Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
• Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
• Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
• Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.
The Kind of Person We’re Looking For
Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:
Missionary, Not Mercenary
You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.
Builder, Not a Bystander
You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.
Craftsperson Under Pressure
Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.
Direct Communicator
You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.
This Is a Long-Term Commitment
Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.
This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.
If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.
Benefits
What We Offer
• Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
• Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
• A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
• The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority.  We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets.
